func BinarySearch(items []int, target int) bool {
	lo, hi := 0, len(items)-1
	for lo <= hi {
		mid := (lo + hi) / 2
		if items[mid] == target {
			return true
		} else if items[mid] < target {
			lo = mid + 1
		} else {
			hi = mid - 1
		}
	}
	return false
}
